searchText: Ethereum Ethash DAG size has reached exactly 5GB. Are there any resources to watch the effect? I have checked several websites that display the hashrate, but i don't see any effect at all. It seems the amount of miners being affected by it was negligible. In 4 days DAG size will be > 5GB. The current dag epoch is 128 _bytes_ shy of 5 GiB. (Gibibytes, binary, not decimal Gig). Next epoch (15,390,000) will be 8MiB over 5 GiB AllCoreDevs in ~8 minutes Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/592 Stream: https://youtu.be/jJaCaS0WbIw Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09
